note: Per-market stage and health snapshot for the dashboard grid. Ingest mode uses cached dispatch + policy lists; signal mix comes from the live FTSE screen or each library latest_summary.json. Admitted markets show epoch-0 buy-tier-level + equal-support near-miss (watch cut: buy-not-now / hold-near-buy). Do not blend NAV into the gate graphic.
